inputs.description: Modpack version — dotted number, NO 'V' prefix (e.g. 1.1.8)

tasks.label: Pack: bundle check (fetchability) — PREFLIGHT
tasks.detail: Every bundle mod downloadable? (CF Approved+downloadUrl, URL 200 via GET). Run before EVERY pack release. BUG-010.

tasks.label: Pack: bundle check (orphans / completeness)
tasks.command: python3 bundle_check.py --orphans "${env:HOME}/Documents/curseforge/minecraft/Instances/Biggess Pack Cat Edition V1 TEST/mods"
tasks.detail: Jars in the instance that NO bundle delivers (would be missing for players).

tasks.label: Pack: sync bundle fileIDs vs GitHub (audit)
tasks.detail: Compare pack bundles vs real GitHub releases — catches stale forks outside the tracking. Preflight before a pack release.

tasks.label: Pack: sync bundle fileIDs (apply)
tasks.detail: Write synced fileIDs into curse.bundle + client_manifest + server_jar + url.bundle (byte-mode, preserves CRLF).

tasks.label: Pack: publish pending changelog (preview)
tasks.detail: Preview cutting memory/changelog-pending.md into the pack CHANGELOG. Add --prepend to actually insert.

tasks.label: Pack: publish pending changelog (PREPEND)
tasks.detail: Insert the pending block into the pack CHANGELOG for real.

tasks.label: Pack: smoke test (server)
tasks.detail: Boot a throwaway server clone, report PASS/FAIL. Never touches the real instance.

tasks.label: Pack: smoke test (server + client auto-join)
tasks.detail: Server stays up, client boots + joins; confirmed via server log. Needs DISPLAY.

tasks.label: Release: dry-run all mods
tasks.detail: Stage 1 verify (tree/branch/targets) + Stage 2 build/plan. Publishes nothing.

tasks.label: Release: EXECUTE all mods (publishes!)
tasks.detail: REAL: tag + build + GitHub + CurseForge + Modrinth. Outward/public.

tasks.label: Local: update instances (dry-run)
tasks.detail: Preview swapping built personal jars into main/TEST/server.

tasks.label: Local: update instances (apply)
tasks.detail: rm old + cp new jars into instances. Launch with -Dmoddirector.devMode=true after.

tasks.label: Housekeep: archive resolved bugs (dry-run)
tasks.detail: Preview moving resolved bugs from BUGS.md to BUGS-archive.md.

tasks.label: Verify tokens (CF + Modrinth)
tasks.detail: Check the upload tokens are valid before a release.
